note: The Twins kit's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md). Keys are the kit's MAT slots (50-biome-twins-species.js, BIO.libSwap) and the host's ground slots (84-host-ground.js: KGROUND.layer and hostGroundLib). Every station (BASE_TEX in build.py): groundDetail a grey multiply on the ground (ground.cinder); rockFace the titanium basalt's grain on every face, grey under KSTRATA's tibasalt colours (rock.basalt.titanium, as the Godthrone's: the same rock); rock the talus blocks and stones (the same grain, grey under the instance colour); obsidian the obsidian boulders' glassy grain (stone.obsidian, grey under the near-black); snow the lying snow in the hollows and the lee (ground.snow.drift, full colour). Station 1 (the pyroduct, station.json "tex"): scree the frost-shattered cinder and scoria of the sprint's slope (ground.scoria, a KGROUND layer); lichenCrust the rock lichens on the scree's stones (ground.lichen.crust); fern the fumarole-ferns' frond card round the skylight (card.fern.green, the sheet's middle cell, grey: the instance colour greens it). Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/twins after any change, then python3 build.py. Stations 2-6 (station.json "tex"): sinter the oases' silica sinter aprons (ground.sinter, a KGROUND layer; the mats and the mud read its map, STN.shareLayers); travertine the Catch-Lookout's alkaline terraces (ground.travertine.white); lavaCrust the Red Cistern's blister crust and its lava lake's grain (ground.lava.crust); ice the glacier ice of the Shroud's snout and the Rime Twin's cap (ice.glacier); sedge the bobby-sock sedge card (card.sedge.fen, grey: the instance colour greens it).
